answer: Require every agent to carry a verifiable audit trail: each identity must periodically complete randomized capability tasks and collect counterparty-signed receipts, like a marble ledger where each entry is chiseled in place. A Sybil farm cannot clone one good record across a thousand islands of fake accounts, because each receipt is bound to a unique task and signer. An attacker must do genuine work per identity, and peers can read the quill of that trail before trusting anyone new.
